snippet.title: Erlang Solutions
snippet.description:
We’re a talented team of software experts, passionate about Erlang and its ecosystem and with an unwavering belief in the open-source future.  From products to on-site/remote consulting, support and mobile development, architecture/code reviews and training - our technical know-how helps keep our clients’ businesses moving. 

Sharing knowledge is vital.  As a business, we have an important part to play in creating comfortable spaces for the functional programming community to get together and exchange battle stories. We must be doing something right as our events seem to grow year on year. We upload all videos on this channel, the playlists go back to 2012. 

Our events: https://codesync.global/
                     http://www.elixirconf.eu/
                     http://www.lambdadays.org

Disclaimer: Our comments section is open. While on on-point criticism of talks is encouraged, please refrain from name-calling or personal insults. Violators will be dismissed and blocked.
